rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Short kerb beside a roundabout, with houses 5 m and 8 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses front straight onto the kerb at 5 m and 8 m; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb here, so room exists, but the stretch is short.
drivers.traffic: Beside a roundabout on a through road.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the kerb; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; some tree shade from the east.

best_section.where: East kerb of Whitmore Street just south of the roundabout
